asks: Who do you think looks at this?
Would you behave differently if I were not here?
description: A face coming down out of the ceiling as though through a skin, features stretched taut by the material it is pushing into. It is where the camera was, and it is doing the same job.
emotes: {it} presses a little further through, and the ceiling gives.
{it} turns to follow you across the room.
{it} relaxes back into the plaster and is almost gone.
looks: The ceiling has taken the shape of a face without breaking, and the strain is visible around the jaw.
The eyes are shut, because opening them would mean tearing through, and it has not decided to yet.
It turns, slowly, following the room, and the ceiling turns with it.
name: a face pressed through the ceiling
says: I am not recording. I am just watching.
There is another one of these in the next room.
You have got very used to me.
